title_en: [Fall Semester 2026] Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project): Final Presentation and Poster File Submission
summary: The final presentation for the Fall 2026 Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project) will be held on Friday, 20 November, from 10:00 to 16:00 in the first-floor corridor of Building 301. Poster files must be submitted as A1 portrait PDF files by Monday, 9 November, at 23:59.
applies_to: Students taking the Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project) in the second semester of the 2026 academic year. For the panel set-up on 19 November, at least one student per laboratory must attend; students who have a class at that time are excluded. Attendance of teaching assistants is not checked; they attend only if needed.

Name the file "Module name_Supervising professor's name_Student name" (e.g. Bio_Professor KimOO_ParkOO).

Upload the poster PDF through the form link https://forms.gle/Vm9HY1ZiX9nyK5pCA by Monday, 9 November, 23:59. For team projects, one representative sends the file by email, named "Professor in charge_names of all team members" (the notice does not state the email address).
If needed, submit a revised version once only, adding "[수정본]" ([Revised]) to the file name (e.g. [수정본]Professor KimJeongi_ParkJeongbo).
If you miss the 9 November deadline, print your poster yourself at your own expense, in A1 portrait size.

On 20 November, bring sticky tape to attach your poster to the panel, and your own power extension cord if you need power for a laptop or other device.
Arrive at the first-floor corridor of Building 301 before 10:00 for the attendance check.
Stay at your place from 10:00 to 16:00 for the professors' individual judging, and be present for the attendance checks at 10:30, 12:00 and 15:30.

After the event, take part in removing posters and tidying the panels, desks and chairs (from Room 104 of Building 301 and other designated lecture rooms); the project ends only when this is complete.
translation:
[Fall Semester 2026] Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project): Final Presentation and Poster File Submission
Posted: 2 November 2026

Fall Semester 2026 Graduation Project: Final Presentation and Poster File Submission

<Final Presentation>
- The final presentation is scheduled for Friday, 20 November, 10:00–16:00 (judging hours), in the first-floor corridor of Building 301.
- Please arrive before 10:00 for the attendance check.
※ If you need an absence confirmation to submit for another class held on the same day, please print and bring your mySNU timetable. It will be issued on the day after your timetable is checked.

<Preparation>
* Poster submission (by Monday, 9 November, 23:59)
Link: https://forms.gle/Vm9HY1ZiX9nyK5pCA

1. Poster submission
- Only PDF files may be uploaded / size A1 / portrait orientation.
- When submitting, name the file "Module name_Supervising professor's name_Student name", e.g. Bio_Professor KimOO_ParkOO.
 * For team projects, one representative should send it by email. (File name: Professor in charge_names of all team members)
- A revised version may be submitted only once, and you must add "[수정본]" ([Revised]) to it, e.g. [수정본]Professor KimJeongi_ParkJeongbo.

2. Poster printing
- Printing of one poster per person is supported.
- Poster size: please follow the A1 standard (594 mm x 841 mm, portrait).
 * Students who print at their own expense should also print in A1 size. A landscape poster may be difficult to attach to the panel.
- Poster file format: PDF (not too large in file size) / A1 size (PPT and HWP files cannot be printed).
※ After the deadline of Monday, 9 November, 23:59, you must print your poster yourself at your own expense.
※ The poster print request will be sent to the printing company on the afternoon of Tuesday, 10 November.

3. Panel set-up
- Panel set-up will take place on Thursday, 19 November, at 15:00.
- As this is the set-up of your own presentation panel, please come to the first-floor corridor of Building 301 (in front of Room 118) by 15:00.
 (At least one student per laboratory must come; students who have a class are excluded.)

4. On the day of the project
- You must bring sticky tape that can be used to attach your poster to the panel.
- Power extension cords: if you need power for a laptop or other device, prepare one yourself.
- Desks: desks and chairs from Room 104 of Building 301 and designated lecture rooms will be used, and you must also tidy them up afterwards.
 * The project ends only after everyone has together removed the posters and finished tidying the panels, desks and chairs.

5. Attendance
- Attendance will be checked at 10:30, 12:00 (when collecting meals) and 15:30 (by roll call or in sequence).
- If you are not present at all three checks, you will be marked absent. (Missing one check because of a class is accepted.)
- If you have an overlapping class, print your mySNU timetable, submit it at the desk on the day, and receive an absence confirmation.
- To avoid any disadvantage in your evaluation due to being absent when professors judge your work, please remain at your place from 10:00 to 16:00.
 * Please note that, depending on the judges' schedules, judging may continue after 15:00.
 (Judging hours: 10:00–16:00 / the whole project presentation ends when judging of all modules is complete.)
- Judging is conducted individually. If you are not present because of attending a class and therefore are not evaluated, this is your own responsibility.
- Attendance of teaching assistants is not checked. (They attend only if needed; it is not mandatory.)

For further enquiries, please contact the department office (undergraduate office). The contact details are given in the original Korean notice.

Addendum: You must have your thesis draft and poster draft reviewed by your supervising professor by Monday, 16 November.
